description: This source file defines an Android activity called BitmapMesh that displays a bitmap and allows touch-based warping of the image using a mesh grid. It includes nested class SampleView, which handles rendering and user interaction via Canvas and touch events.

classes.name: BitmapMesh
classes.description: An Android activity that displays and interacts with a bitmap using a mesh grid.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View that draws a bitmap mesh and handles touch events to warp the image.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: setXY
methods.description: Sets the (x, y) coordinates in the specified float array at a given index.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mesh grid and loads the bitmap resource.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the background and the warped bitmap mesh on the canvas.

methods.name: warp
methods.description: Adjusts the positions of mesh vertices to create a warping effect based on a focal point.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input to update the warp destination point and redraw the view.
